9-panel cinematic storyboard sheet derived from Image 1. Mix Wide, Medium, and Tight shots of the same scene. No borders between panels.

Layout: 3x3 grid (9 panels) in a 16:9 landscape image.

Scene: Sun-drenched coastal cinematic still in modern social-first lifestyle beauty campaign style, clean bright true-to-life grading with crisp whites and one vivid coral accent pop against neutral base, 16:9 wide establishing frame. Scarlett (Image 2) in oversized white linen button-down shirt worn loose and slightly open with light beige natural linen shorts and simple tan leather sandals strides energetically toward camera along the pale concrete Bondi promenade path, body mid-stride with forward momentum, one foot lifted, torso angled slightly as she glances once toward the open ocean with the barest almost-laugh catching on her vivid coral lips that form the sharp colour hero against the white linen and pale concrete. Soft-focus mid-ground surfers carry boards along the path behind her, continuous white metal railing running parallel overlooking the sand and turquoise ocean, expansive bright sky and wind-swept coastal vista filling the background with occasional soft green foliage accents. High clean harsh midday sun directly overhead casting short hard shadows and brilliant specular highlights on the pale concrete and white railing, brilliant outdoor glare, shallow depth of field keeping background soft while the walking figure stays sharp and immediate, slight anamorphic texture and natural handheld micro-energy in the locked wide-to-mid framing that emphasizes freedom and sensory coastal motion just beginning.

Every panel is a shot of the same scene as Image 1 — keep the characters, wardrobe, lighting, color grade, and texture consistent across all panels.

No text, dialogue bubbles, scene numbers, or watermarks.

Reference images define identity — keep every referenced character, object, and location consistent with its reference image; never render a reference image itself as a separate panel or subject.
